rows.quote: We shipped our first Vera Rubin samples to customers earlier this week, and we remain on track to commence production shipments in the second half of the year.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA管理层称，公司本周已向客户交付首批Vera Rubin样品，并预计2026年下半年开始量产出货。
rows.reason: NVIDIA reports Vera Rubin samples already shipped to customers and guides to production shipments in 2H 2026; the latter is a forecast, not completed production shipments.

rows.quote: In fiscal year 2026, we unveiled the NVIDIA Rubin platform, which is expected to commence production shipments in the second half of fiscal year 2027.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA预计Rubin平台将在FY2027下半年开始生产出货。
rows.reason: Gives an FY2027 H2 production-shipment expectation for Rubin, but the fiscal-year timing does not establish calendar-year shipments or customer deployment.

rows.quote: We are on track to commence production shipments of VeraRubin in the second half of this year starting in Q3.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 表示，Vera Rubin 计划于2026年下半年开始量产出货，起始时间为第三季度。
rows.reason: Management guides to production shipments starting in Q3 2026; this is prospective guidance, not evidence shipments have begun.

rows.quote: Announced the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, including the NVIDIA Vera CPU, the world’s first processor purpose-built for agentic AI, and NVIDIA BlueField®-4 STX, accelerated storage infrastructure for agentic AI factories.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA宣布Vera Rubin平台，包括面向智能体AI的Vera CPU及BlueField-4 STX加速存储基础设施。
rows.reason: The platform and Vera CPU announcement establishes product scope, not shipment, deployment, or realized revenue.

rows.quote: We expect our Rubin platform to start shipping in the second half of fiscal year 2027.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA 表示，预计Rubin平台将在FY2027下半年开始出货。
rows.reason: Repeats a fiscal-year shipment expectation without showing actual shipments or customer deployments.

rows.quote: AI Summit — SK Group and NVIDIA today announced plans for a $500-billion-plus comprehensive partnership to establish AI infrastructure serving the surging demand for global compute. The two sides signed letters of intent to formalize the agreement, which spans from AI factory construction to AI memory supply.
rows.one_line: SK Group与NVIDIA于2026年7月24日宣布计划开展规模超过5000亿美元的综合合作，并签署意向书，合作涵盖AI工厂建设和AI内存供应。
rows.reason: The announced partnership and LOI describe AI-factory construction and memory supply, but formal implementation and resulting deployments are not established.

rows.quote: This cloud will use the NVIDIA ® DSX™ platform and deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin accelerated computing powered by SK hynix HBM4, with the first AI factory planned to come online in 2027.
rows.one_line: SK Telecom计划在2027年让首座AI工厂上线，该工厂将采用NVIDIA DSX平台和由SK hynix HBM4驱动的Vera Rubin加速计算。
rows.reason: SK Telecom says its Vera Rubin-powered first AI factory is planned to come online in 2027; this is a deployment plan, not an operating facility.

rows.quote: SK hynix is also entering into a long-term AI memory partnership with NVIDIA.
rows.one_line: SK hynix与NVIDIA建立长期AI内存合作关系。
rows.reason: A long-term memory partnership may support supply, but does not itself establish Vera Rubin shipments, deployments, or revenue.

rows.quote: The 200-megawatt AI factory is expected to feature advanced NVIDIA AI infrastructure including the NVIDIA Vera Rubin and NVIDIA Blackwell platforms.
rows.one_line: 这座预计建成 200 兆瓦的 AI 工厂预计将配置包括 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 和 NVIDIA Blackwell 平台在内的 NVIDIA AI 基础设施。
rows.reason: Describes a planned AI factory expected to feature Vera Rubin, but gives no evidence it is operating or hardware has been delivered.

rows.quote: Core to it all: NAVER, Brookfield and NVIDIA will expand NAVER’s NVIDIA DSX AI factory at its GAK Sejong data center to 200 megawatts — roughly 100,000 GPUs, built on the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform — more than tripling the initial buildout announced in June .
rows.one_line: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 7 月 24 日称，NAVER、Brookfield 和 NVIDIA 将把 NAVER 的 GAK Sejong AI 工厂扩至 200 兆瓦、约 10 万块 GPU，并采用 Vera Rubin 平台。
rows.reason: Describes a planned expansion using Vera Rubin GPUs; it is a deployment commitment, not a completed deployment.

rows.quote: Broadening initial plans announced in June , the expanded collaboration will deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure powered by SK hynix HBM4 memory.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 7 月 24 日称，扩大的 SK 合作将部署由 SK hynix HBM4 内存支持的 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 基础设施。
rows.reason: NVIDIA describes planned deployment of Vera Rubin infrastructure in an expanded collaboration; actual deployment is not shown.

rows.quote: On the May 20 earnings call, Colette Kress, Executive Vice President and CFO, said Vera “opens a brand new $200 billion TAM for NVIDIA, a market we have never addressed before,” adding: “We have visibility to nearly $20 billion in total CPU revenue this year, setting us up to become the world-leading CPU supplier.”
rows.one_line: NVIDIA CFO Colette Kress 在 2026 年 5 月 20 日财报电话会上表示，公司预计当年 CPU 总收入接近 200 亿美元。
rows.reason: NVIDIA’s CFO forecasts nearly $20 billion in CPU revenue for the year; this is guidance, not realized revenue.

rows.quote: Vivek Arya of Bank of America asked whether the $20 billion was standalone or already embedded in Vera Rubin systems. CEO Jensen Huang: “The $20 billion is for standalone CPU.”
rows.one_line: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 在 2026 年 5 月 20 日财报电话会上澄清，接近 200 亿美元的 CPU 收入预期指独立 CPU。
rows.reason: Clarifies that the nearly $20 billion forecast is for standalone CPUs, but does not establish revenue actually earned.

rows.quote: That day, one before AMD’s Advancing AI conference, NVIDIA published the full architecture and benchmarks for Vera, its first CPU built on custom Olympus cores.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 7 月 21 日发布了 Vera 架构和基准测试；Vera 是其首款采用定制 Olympus 核心的 CPU。
rows.reason: Architecture and benchmark publication documents product development, not commercial shipments, deployments, or revenue.

rows.quote: Two quarters of visibility without disclosure would tell that the $20 billion is harder to isolate than the May call implied.
rows.one_line: TIKR 作者认为，若未来两个季度没有单独披露 CPU 收入，接近 200 亿美元的预期可能比 5 月电话会暗示的更难单独核实。
rows.reason: Raises a concern that standalone CPU revenue may be difficult to verify absent separate disclosure; it questions observability rather than proving weak sales.

rows.quote: Two drivers carry the mid-case revenue growth rate of around 23% annually. The first is the standalone CPU line Huang placed outside the $1 trillion forecast, a category with no prior revenue history at NVIDIA.
rows.one_line: TIKR 作者认为，独立 CPU 产品线是其估值中约 23% 年收入增长假设的驱动因素之一。
rows.reason: Identifies standalone CPU as a prospective revenue-growth driver, an analytical assumption rather than a reported commercial result.

rows.quote: The second is rising content per rack as Vera Rubin’s seven-chip architecture, which Kress said starts shipping in Q3 and ramps into Q4, replaces narrower Blackwell configurations.
rows.one_line: TIKR 作者转述 NVIDIA CFO Colette Kress 的说法：Vera Rubin 七芯片架构从第三季度开始出货，并在第四季度爬坡。
rows.reason: Relays guidance that Vera Rubin starts shipping in Q3 and ramps in Q4; this is a schedule expectation, not actual shipments.

rows.quote: The launch of a 2-gigawatt data center using Vera Rubin chips and HBM4 memory is planned for 2027, and it will be an important step in strengthening the global AI infrastructure.
rows.one_line: Mezha报道，采用 Vera Rubin 芯片和 HBM4 内存的 2 吉瓦数据中心计划于 2027 年启用。
rows.reason: Reports a Vera Rubin data-center launch planned for 2027; the launch remains prospective.

rows.quote: Nvidia said it's secured AI memory supply from South Korea's SK Hynix , as the chipmaker tries to lock in a key component for its advanced processors and systems.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA表示已 확보来自SK海力士的AI内存供应，以保障其先进处理器和系统所需的关键组件。
rows.reason: Reported AI-memory supply is relevant to readiness but does not show Vera Rubin shipments, deployments, or revenue.

rows.quote: SK Hynix affiliate SK Telecom will build a cloud business using Nvidia's Vera Rubin systems.
rows.one_line: SK海力士旗下SK Telecom将使用NVIDIA Vera Rubin系统建设云业务。
rows.reason: Reports SK Telecom’s intention to build a cloud business using Vera Rubin systems; this is a deployment plan.

rows.quote: Its data center segment alone generated roughly $194 billion over its most recent fiscal year, more than 11 times AMD's entire data center business, and its new Vera Rubin platform has ramped into full production with demand visibility stretching into the trillions of dollars.
rows.one_line: 作者 Micah Zimmerman 称，NVIDIA 数据中心分部在最近一个财年收入约 1940 亿美元，并称 Vera Rubin 平台已进入全面量产、需求可见度达数万亿美元。
rows.reason: A third-party author claims Vera Rubin has reached full production and cites demand visibility, but the material provides no underlying shipment or revenue results.

rows.quote: CPUs can be especially good at processing AI agent tasks, which is why some tech companies, including Alphabet, are designing their own CPUs to be used in AI data centers.
rows.one_line: 作者称，CPU 擅长处理 AI 代理任务，Alphabet 等科技公司正在设计用于 AI 数据中心的自研 CPU。
rows.reason: General discussion of CPU use in AI data centers informs potential demand but provides no Vera commercialization result.

rows.quote: Nvidia recently revealed more details about its next-generation Vera CPU for AI , which will directly compete with Intel and AMD CPUs.
rows.one_line: 作者称，NVIDIA 最近公布了面向 AI 的下一代 Vera CPU 更多信息，该产品将直接与 Intel 和 AMD 的 CPU 竞争。
rows.reason: Describes Vera’s competitive positioning, not actual shipments, customer deployments, or revenue.

rows.quote: SpaceX, OpenAI, and Anthropic are all evaluating the Vera CPU now, and Nvidia says its processor has 50% better performance for AI agents than the x86 CPU architecture used by Intel and AMD.
rows.one_line: 作者称，SpaceX、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 正在评估 Vera CPU；NVIDIA 表示其处理 AI 代理的性能比 Intel 和 AMD 使用的 x86 CPU 架构高 50%。
rows.reason: Reports customers are evaluating Vera CPU and repeats NVIDIA’s performance claim; evaluation is an early commercial signal, not deployment or sales.

rows.quote: The hard part will be chipping away at Intel's and AMD's server CPU market shares, which are currently 67% and 33%, respectively.
rows.one_line: 作者称，Intel 和 AMD 当前分别占有服务器 CPU 市场份额的 67% 和 33%，NVIDIA 进入市场需要争夺其份额。
rows.reason: Identifies incumbent server CPU market shares as a competitive hurdle for Vera’s commercial adoption.

rows.quote: Separately, Nvidia is teaming up with SK Group to build more than 2 gigawatts of AI data centres on the Korean Peninsula.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA报道称其正与SK Group合作，在朝鲜半岛建设容量超过2吉瓦的AI数据中心。
rows.reason: NVIDIA describes a planned partnership to build AI data centers, but does not establish completed Vera deployments.

rows.quote: Huang said the reports are "not true." He also explained that "Vera Rubin is already in production. Giant amounts of production incoming."
rows.one_line: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang回应延迟报道称 Vera Rubin 已经投产，并称即将有大量产量。
rows.reason: The CEO says Vera Rubin is already in production and that substantial production is incoming; this is an attributed management statement, not shipment evidence.

rows.quote: The partnership includes SK Telecom's plan to develop a 2-gigawatt AI cloud in South Korea using Nvidia's AI platform and Vera Rubin computing systems powered by SK hynix (SKHY) HBM4 memory chips. The first AI data center is expected to begin operations in 2027.
rows.one_line: 媒体报道，SK Telecom计划在韩国建设2吉瓦AI云，首座AI数据中心预计2027年开始运营，并使用NVIDIA Vera Rubin计算系统。
rows.reason: Reports a planned 2027 AI-data-center opening using Vera Rubin, but labels the information rumor and does not show deployment has occurred.

rows.quote: When Nvidia announced its next-generation Vera Rubin chip platform in January this year, Pichai pointed out that Alphabet will "bring the impressive capabilities of the Rubin platform to our customers."
rows.one_line: Alphabet首席执行官Sundar Pichai表示，Alphabet将把Rubin平台的能力带给客户。
rows.reason: Alphabet’s stated intention to bring Rubin capabilities to customers indicates prospective customer adoption, not a completed deployment.

rows.quote: Importantly, Nvidia has started the volume production of Vera Rubin processors, and it plans to begin shipping them to customers this fall.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA已开始Vera Rubin处理器量产，并计划于2026年秋季开始向客户发货。
rows.reason: A third party reports volume production has started and fall customer shipments are planned; production is asserted, while shipments remain prospective.

rows.quote: A letter of intent typically sets out initial terms for an agreement and is usually non-binding.
rows.one_line: DCD指出，意向书通常列明协议初步条款，且通常不具约束力，说明合作尚不等于正式落实。
rows.reason: General information about letters of intent helps interpret partnership status but is not direct evidence of Vera commercialization.

rows.quote: The 2GW refers to the announcement made by SK Telecom in June 2026 , when it detailed plans to deploy a "gigawatt-scale" AI cloud platform in South Korea based on the Nvidia DSX platform.
rows.one_line: DCD报道，SK Telecom于2026年6月公布计划，拟在韩国部署基于NVIDIA DSX平台的吉瓦级AI云平台，容量为2GW。
rows.reason: Reports SK Telecom’s plan for a 2GW AI cloud; it supports prospective deployment, not a completed Vera installation.

rows.quote: Powered by the chip giant’s Vera Rubin hardware and SK Hynix HBM4, the first AI factory is slated to come online in 2027.
rows.one_line: DCD报道，首座AI工厂计划于2027年上线，由NVIDIA Vera Rubin硬件和SK Hynix HBM4提供支持。
rows.reason: Reports the first Vera Rubin-powered AI factory is slated for 2027; this is a deployment forecast.

rows.quote: “By leveraging SK Hynix’s AI memory and SK Telecom’s AI infrastructure capabilities, SK will collaborate with Nvidia to build a world-class AI factory, helping Korea transcend its role as a leading adopter of AI and become a global hub that drives AI innovation.”
rows.one_line: SK Group董事长崔泰源表示，SK将利用SK Hynix的AI内存和SK Telecom的AI基础设施能力，与NVIDIA合作建设AI工厂。
rows.reason: SK Group’s chairman says the parties will collaborate to build an AI factory; this is a stated intention, not an operating deployment.

rows.quote: Three things need to hold: Blackwell Ultra and Vera Rubin ramps stay on schedule, hyperscaler capex commitments do not slip, and Q2 revenue lands at or above the $91 billion guide when NVIDIA reports on August 26.
rows.one_line: Vandita Jadeja认为，NVIDIA股价重回5万亿美元市值的判断依赖Blackwell Ultra和Vera Rubin按计划爬坡、超大规模云厂商资本开支承诺不延后，以及8月26日公布的第二季度收入达到或超过910亿美元指引。
rows.reason: Discusses ramp timing and NVIDIA-wide revenue guidance as investor considerations, but supplies no direct Vera commercialization result.

rows.quote: Its new Vera server CPU targets a $200 billion market, with $20 billion in Vera revenue expected this fiscal year alone despite only recently shipping as a standalone product.
rows.one_line: 报道说，NVIDIA 新款 Vera 服务器 CPU 面向2000亿美元市场，预计仅本财年 Vera 收入就达200亿美元；该产品近期才作为独立产品出货。
rows.reason: Reports an approximately $20 billion Vera revenue expectation for the fiscal year; it is a forecast, not realized revenue.

rows.quote: The 324,000-square-foot D1 facility will serve as a key hub in Wistron’s global AI manufacturing network and is expected to produce both the NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Superchip and the next-generation NVIDIA Vera Rubin Superchip.
rows.one_line: The Manufacturer 于 2026 年 7 月 31 日报道，Wistron 德州 D1 工厂预计将生产 NVIDIA Vera Rubin Superchip。
rows.reason: Reports Wistron’s facility is expected to produce Vera Rubin, indicating manufacturing readiness rather than actual Vera production or shipment.

rows.quote: Right now we produce the NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Superchip, and beyond, we are also going to produce the NVIDIA Vera Rubin Superchip here.
rows.one_line: Wistron 董事长 Simon Lin 表示，工厂目前生产 NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Superchip，未来也将在此生产 Vera Rubin Superchip。
rows.reason: Wistron’s chair says the facility will produce Vera Rubin in future; this is a prospective manufacturing statement.

rows.quote: Alibaba, ByteDance, Meta, Oracle, CoreWeave, Lambda, Nebius, and NScale have already signed up to deploy the chips in their respective clouds.
rows.one_line: 媒体报道称，阿里巴巴、字节跳动、Meta、甲骨文、CoreWeave、Lambda、Nebius 和 NScale 已签约在各自云平台部署 Vera CPU。
rows.reason: Reports customers have signed up to deploy Vera CPUs in their clouds; this is a commercial commitment, not proof of completed deployment or revenue.

rows.quote: The follow-on to Nvidia's Grace CPU promises 88 custom Armv9.2 cores, 176 threads, support for up to 1.5 TB of LPDDR5X memory, and, critically, availability as a standalone platform independent of Nvidia's GPUs.
rows.one_line: 媒体介绍称，Vera 提供独立于 NVIDIA GPU 的独立 CPU 平台，并支持最多 1.5 TB LPDDR5X 内存。
rows.reason: Describes Vera as a standalone CPU platform and its specifications, but not actual commercial outcomes.

rows.quote: Nvidia claims that in workloads representative of agentic AI, Vera delivers 1.8x higher per core performance.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA 声称，在具有代表性的 agentic AI 工作负载中，Vera 的单核性能是 AMD 128 核 Epyc 9755 的 1.8 倍。
rows.reason: NVIDIA’s performance claim may affect product appeal but does not establish shipments, deployments, or realized revenue.

rows.quote: We fully anticipate Vera to sell extremely well, if not for its performance characteristics, then because if you want more than eight Rubins, it's probably coming with a Vera CPU attached.
rows.one_line: 记者预计 Vera 销售表现会很强，并判断购买超过八个 Rubin 的客户很可能会同时购买 Vera CPU。
rows.reason: A journalist forecasts strong Vera sales and possible CPU attachment to Rubin systems; this is an expectation, not a sales result.

rows.quote: Nvidia already expects Vera to open roughly $200 billion in addressable server CPU revenue and is guiding to around $20 billion in Vera sales this fiscal year.
rows.one_line: 报道提到，NVIDIA 预计 Vera 可对应约 2000 亿美元的服务器 CPU 可服务市场，并预计本财年 Vera 销售额约为 200 亿美元。
rows.reason: Reports NVIDIA’s roughly $20 billion Vera sales guidance; it is a forecast rather than realized revenue.

rows.quote: Benchmarks highlighted in this NVIDIA technical blog show that the NVIDIA Vera CPU, part of NVIDIA Vera BlueField-4 STX , delivers up to 3.21x higher throughput than an x86 CPU in a two-stage compression and encryption pipeline.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA称，Vera CPU在两阶段压缩与加密流程中的吞吐量最高达到x86 CPU的3.21倍。
rows.reason: NVIDIA’s benchmark claim may inform product competitiveness but gives no commercial result.

rows.quote: SpaceX plans to power the first Starmind satellites with Nvidia’s Vera CPUs and Rubin GPUs, hardware the chipmaker recently positioned as part of its emerging space computing portfolio.
rows.one_line: SpaceX计划在首批Starmind卫星上使用NVIDIA Vera CPU和Rubin GPU。
rows.reason: Reports SpaceX’s plan to use Vera CPUs and Rubin GPUs in Starmind satellites; this is a prospective deployment.

rows.quote: Commercial shipments of the platform are expected to begin later this year.
rows.one_line: NVIDIA的Space-1 Vera Rubin平台预计于2026年晚些时候开始商业出货。
rows.reason: Reports expected later-year commercial shipments of Space-1 Vera Rubin; this is a forecast, not completed shipments.

rows.quote: The facility is already producing the NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Superchip and preparing to produce the NVIDIA Vera Rubin Superchip, part of a combined $700 million commitment to U.S. advanced manufacturing that has created more than 500 jobs, expanding to 1,000 jobs by the end of the year.
rows.one_line: Wistron位于德克萨斯州沃思堡的工厂已生产NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Superchip，并正准备生产NVIDIA Vera Rubin Superchip；该先进制造承诺已创造500多个就业岗位，预计年底增至1,000个。
rows.reason: The Wistron facility is preparing to produce Vera Rubin, an actual readiness step but not evidence of Vera production or customer shipments.

rows.quote: "With respect to the Starmind AI satellite, which will be essentially an optimized Vera Rubin NVL72 computer, this is not some sort of far future distant thing; we expect to start launching this next year," Musk said.
rows.one_line: Elon Musk 表示，搭载优化版 Vera Rubin NVL72 的 Starmind AI 卫星预计于 2027 年开始发射。
rows.reason: Musk expects Starmind satellite launches in 2027; this is a prospective customer deployment, not an actual launch or Vera sale.

rows.quote: In a separate X post Tuesday, SpaceX announced it was “partnering with Nvidia to design the Starmind AI1 satellite compute payload,” and that “Each of the Starmind satellites will include Nvidia Rubin GPUs and Vera CPUs for datacenter class space compute.”
rows.one_line: SpaceX于2026年8月4日在X上宣布与NVIDIA合作设计Starmind AI1卫星计算载荷，并称每颗卫星将配备NVIDIA Rubin GPU和Vera CPU。
rows.reason: SpaceX announced a partnership to design a payload using Rubin GPUs and Vera CPUs; the planned use is not a completed deployment.

rows.quote: The next generation, Vera Rubin, begins production shipments in fiscal Q3 2027, a new silicon architecture on the annual cadence management treats as a pillar of its position.
rows.one_line: Trefis Team报道，NVIDIA下一代Vera Rubin将在FY2027第三季度开始生产出货。
rows.reason: Reports a Q3 FY2027 production-shipment start; this is a third-party account of expected timing, not proof shipments occurred.

rows.quote: The Vera Rubin platform, Dynamo 1.0 inference software, and named commitments with OpenAI, Meta, and Anthropic push customers deeper into CUDA and NVLink.
rows.one_line: 作者认为，Vera Rubin平台、Dynamo 1.0推理软件及与OpenAI、Meta和Anthropic的承诺会加深客户对CUDA和NVLink的使用。
rows.reason: The author cites platform commitments and customer lock-in as adoption drivers, but does not report completed deployments or sales.

rows.quote: But during the second half of this year, Nvidia will start shipping commercial quantities of its new Vera Rubin systems, which include the Rubin GPU, Vera central processing unit (CPU), and a series of upgraded networking components.
rows.one_line: 作者称 NVIDIA 将在2026年下半年开始出货商业数量的 Vera Rubin 系统。
rows.reason: Predicts commercial-quantity Vera Rubin system shipments in 2H 2026; this is a forecast, not an actual shipment result.

rows.quote: That's why, according to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang , every frontier model company in the AI industry plans to adopt Vera Rubin systems at launch, which wasn't the case with Blackwell.
rows.one_line: 作者转述 NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 的说法，所有前沿模型公司都计划在 Vera Rubin 上市时采用该系统。
rows.reason: Relays management’s claim that frontier-model companies plan launch adoption; this is prospective demand, not confirmed deployment.

rows.quote: Bearish confirmation would call for a hyperscaler capital-spending cut, a material Blackwell delay, or evidence that the $500 billion financing platform is struggling to place capital.
rows.one_line: Gerelyn Terzo将超大规模云厂商削减资本开支、Blackwell出现重大延迟，或5000亿美元融资平台难以投放资金列为看空确认条件。
rows.reason: Lists general conditions for a bearish view, but provides no direct evidence about Vera shipments, deployments, or revenue.

rows.quote: Nvidia’s latest generation of AI chips, the Nvidia Rubin GPUs, expected to ship later this year , may face supply delays amid ongoing geopolitical pressures and supply chain constraints.
rows.one_line: Network World 于 2026 年 4 月 9 日报道称，NVIDIA Rubin GPU 预计当年稍后出货，但可能因地缘政治压力和供应链限制而延迟。
rows.reason: Reports possible Rubin supply delays from geopolitical and supply-chain constraints, a risk to shipment timing; it describes a possibility, not a confirmed delay.

rows.quote: We expect investors to focus on: (1) details of Nvidia's r ecently announced $500bn financing platform with partners; (2) the shape of the Rubin product ramp in 2H; (3) future gross margin trends; (4) potential upside from agentic AI to CPUs.
rows.one_line: Goldman Sachs预计投资者将关注NVIDIA近期宣布的5000亿美元合作伙伴融资平台、2026年下半年Rubin产品爬坡、未来毛利率趋势，以及智能体AI对CPU的潜在利好。
rows.reason: Describes investor focus on the Rubin ramp and CPU opportunity without reporting realized commercialization results.

rows.quote: Second, the firm expects focus on the shape of the Rubin ramp in the second half and 2027, and evidence of adoption "in new customer cohorts (AI labs, neoclouds, sovereigns)."
rows.one_line: 高盛预计投资者将关注 Rubin 在 2026 年下半年及 2027 年的爬坡情况，以及其在新客户群中的采用证据。
rows.reason: Highlights adoption evidence investors will watch for in customer cohorts; it does not itself report that adoption has occurred.

rows.quote: Fourth, it expects attention on CPU demand driven by agentic AI, with Nvidia's CPU-only racks expected to begin shipping in the second half.
rows.one_line: Goldman Sachs预计投资者将关注由智能体AI驱动的CPU需求，NVIDIA纯CPU机架预计于2026年下半年开始出货。
rows.reason: Reports CPU-only racks are expected to begin shipping in 2H; this is a shipment forecast, not completed shipments or revenue.

rows.quote: In June 2026, CoreWeave completed the industry-first bring-up and validation of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72.
rows.one_line: CoreWeave称其于2026年6月完成NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72的bring-up和验证。
rows.reason: CoreWeave reports completed Vera Rubin NVL72 bring-up and validation, an actual deployment-readiness milestone but not a customer production deployment or sale.

rows.quote: With Vera Rubin NVL72, CoreWeave shared the first measured performance results: up to 10x more tokens per second per megawatt than NVIDIA GB200 NVL72.
rows.one_line: CoreWeave公布称，Vera Rubin NVL72每兆瓦每秒生成的token数最高可达NVIDIA GB200 NVL72的10倍。
rows.reason: CoreWeave reports measured performance results, which may inform product value but do not establish shipments, deployments, or revenue.

rows.quote: At the system level, modular cable-free trays make assembly up to 90x faster than Blackwell and simplifies serviceability, and software-defined NVLink routing reroutes around faults to keep operation continuous with less maintenance overhead.
rows.one_line: CoreWeave称，Vera Rubin的模块化无缆托盘使系统组装速度最高达到Blackwell的90倍，并可通过软件定义的NVLink路由绕开故障。
rows.reason: CoreWeave describes assembly and serviceability features; these are product attributes, not commercial outcomes.
